form:FormGroup.label: Collection
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of the Solr collection that holds this index.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: The Solr collection that holds this index.

form:FormGroup.label: Instance Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Type of Solr installation to connect to: Single Node or Solr Cloud. Default is Single Node.

form:FormGroup.label: Solr URLs
form:FormGroup.helpText: URLs of the Solr servers, one per line, e.g. http://solr.example.com:8983/solr. Single Node needs exactly one URL. Not used when the instance type is Solr Cloud and 'Use ZK' is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: One per line. Single Node needs exactly one.

form:FormGroup.label: ZooKeeper Hosts
form:FormGroup.helpText: ZooKeeper hosts for the Solr Cloud cluster, one per line, in the form host:port, e.g. zk1.example.com:2181. Needed when the instance type is Solr Cloud and 'Use ZK' is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: One host:port per line. Needed for Solr Cloud with Use ZK ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: ZooKeeper Path
form:FormGroup.helpText: Optional ZooKeeper chroot path where the Solr configuration is held, e.g. /solr. Leave blank if Solr uses the ZooKeeper root. Only used when the instance type is Solr Cloud and 'Use ZK' is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Main Time Field Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of the date field used to apply the query time range. Default is EventTime.

form:FormGroup.label: Default Extraction Pipeline
form:FormGroup.helpText: Pipeline used to extract field values from the original events at search time, when a dashboard or query does not specify its own extraction pipeline.

form:FormGroup.label: Data Retention Expression (matching data will be deleted)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Documents in this index that match this expression are deleted by the 'Solr Index Retention' job. If the expression has no terms, nothing is deleted.
